bio: This restaurant is located in a charming old farmhouse right next to the Josef Fritz winery. The interior is elegant and attractive, with minimalist-style decor; outside, the courtyard offers a delightful setting for summer dining. The kitchen presents a four- or six-course set menu that draws inspiration from Nordic cuisine but also incorporates international influences. The dishes are packed with flavour and many of the herbs used are grown in the courtyard. A vegetarian version of the set menu can be arranged if you order in advance....
